Home.heroBody: Agarwood, resin and flowers from four realms, distilled in Dubai. Nobody can smell a perfume through a screen, so turn the astrolabe instead and let it point you to three.
Home.sequenceLabel: The house, told on the plate of an astrolabe
Home.descentLine: Every realm rises from the same brass plate, driven by the gears below it.
Home.scrollHint: Scroll, or use the arrow keys, to turn the plate

Finder.title: The astrolabe
Finder.intro: Turn the outer ring to a family, the middle ring to the hour you will wear it, and the plate to how strong you like it. The rule swings to the three perfumes that fit best.
Finder.hint: Drag a ring on the astrolabe, or set it here. Arrow keys turn the ring in focus.
Finder.closestBody: Nothing we make matches all three settings, so these are the nearest.
Finder.intensityOff: {n, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} from your intensity
Finder.live: The rule points to {first}, then {second} and {third}.
Finder.liveClosest: Nothing matches exactly. The closest are {first}, {second} and {third}.
